title: Design System: 中大穿梭校巴

shadows.name: segment
shadows.purpose: The selected half of the start/end segment. Nowhere else.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: 150ms color and border changes on controls.

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary actions: 定位, current location, and map links.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dadce0; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f1f3f4; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segment
components.description: Sets whether the next pick is the start or the end.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: #e4e6ea; } .ds-segment button { height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #5f6368; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-segment-on { background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 28, 30, 0.18); } .ds-segment button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Place field
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="输入地点名称" aria-label="地点名称" />
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dadce0; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #0b57d0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5f6368; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0b57d0; outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Place chip
components.description: A campus place. Selected when it is the active start or end.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip">大学站</button><button class="ds-chip ds-chip-on">邵逸夫堂</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dadce0; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-on { background: #e8f0fe; color: #0b57d0; border-color: rgba(11, 87, 208, 0.25); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.html:
起点和终点

现在点地图或地点，会记成起点。
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 500 16px/1.375 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #5f6368; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Route mark
components.description: The line number. Fill is the route's own color, not Browser Blue.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: #6b4c9a; color: #ffffff; font: 600 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a working tool, finished the way Safari, Chrome, and Edge finish their own settings. A student outdoors, in daylight, picks a start and an end and reads which bus to take. The ground is a cool gray, the panels are white, and one blue does selection, focus, and links. Route colors stay on the route mark only, because they are data.

The old warm paper ground, serif titles, and wine accent are the anti-reference. Nothing else is added on top of those three browsers.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray page, white panels, one blue
One system sans, sized by role
Hairline borders, not shadows, except the selected segment
The answer is a short settings list led by a rounded-square route mark

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Browser Blue is the only chrome color. Route colors never become the page accent.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Errors use Error Surface with Error Ink. Close-stop warnings use Warning Surface with Warning Ink. Those colors mean a state, not a theme.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a serif, a display face, or a second sans for headings.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Cards, route rows, and the map frame do not float. A shadow on a panel is a mistake.

dos: Do keep the page on Grouped Gray and the panels on Surface.
Do use Browser Blue for the selected chip, the link, the caret, and the focus outline.
Do lead a recommendation with the rounded-square route mark and the stop names as a list.
Do keep controls at 44px. The page is used outdoors, on a phone.
donts: Don't bring back the warm paper ground, the serif title, or the wine accent.
Don't paint the page with a route color.
Don't put a legend over the map credit.
Don't add a second typeface, a gradient ground, or a floating card shadow.
